goal: ADR 0005 Phases 0-2: make autoloop measurably more capable per token via a deterministic evidence spine (token profiling, delegation receipts with generation fencing, admission/budgets, one verify predicate with content-addressed check cache, red-proof safeguards, deterministic review supervisor), shadow mode first; zero recurring model tokens
grill_summary: Owner directives: token efficiency first-class; token-poor (no enforced independent reviewers, no panels, no LLM judge, no always-on meta agent); profile before optimizing; deterministic Tier-0 first; reject savings that weaken gates or complete less. ADR 0005 (Astra, e03050f+03548c3) binding. Phases 0-2 only; Phase 3 remote evaluator awaits owner provisioning off-machine.
